review.finding: `_single_parent` swallows `ReviewAttributionError` from `_run_git` and returns `None`. Both call sites pass a SHA that was just resolved by `rev-parse --verify refs/heads/...` (verify:342/376) or asserted equal to it (ship:425/442), so `rev-list` can only fail STRUCTURALLY here (git missing, timeout, corrupt object). The except turns that structural failure into an ancestry verdict: verify() returns `ok=False` with detail 'parent None vs pinned reviewed_head ...' instead of raising, and ship() reports "shipped_head X's parent None does not equal pinned reviewed_head" - an operator reads that as a merge/ancestry problem, not a git failure. Fail-closed either way, so non-blocking.
review.suggestion: Drop the try/except in `_single_parent` and let `_run_git`'s ReviewAttributionError propagate (the CLI already maps it to exit 1 / BLOCK with the real git stderr).
